name: 1-Month CS Skill-Building Plan
description: Fundamentals revision -> LeetCode habit -> Personal project build. Day 1 of the plan lands on whatever start date you pick at import time.

tasks.title: Day 1: Arrays, Strings, Big-O
checklist: Review time/space complexity rules
Solve 3-4 easy array/string problems
Be able to explain O(n) vs O(n^2) out loud

tasks.title: Day 2: Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues
checklist: Implement a singly linked list from scratch
Build a stack and queue using it
Solve 2-3 easy problems on each

tasks.title: Day 3: Recursion + Trees
checklist: Practice recursion (factorial, fibonacci)
Learn tree traversals (inorder/preorder/postorder)
Do NOT rush this day

tasks.title: Day 4: Hashing + Graphs (intro)
checklist: Review hashmap/set internals (collisions, O(1) avg lookup)
Solve a few hashmap problems
Intro to BFS/DFS on a grid

tasks.title: Day 5: Mixed Review + Mock
checklist: 5 random easy/medium problems across all topics
20 min each, no looking things up
Note gaps to revisit

checklist: Neetcode roadmap order, start of Blind 75. 20-30 min limit per problem before checking solution.
